reviewer_role: Independent source-selection and transcription reviewer. This is not independent scientific peer review, experimental replication, raw-data reanalysis or legal clearance.

source.title: Lignin Reinforcement in Polybutylene Succinate Copolymers
source.canonical_hash_method: SHA-256 of sorted compact UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=False and allow_nan=False, followed by one LF.
source.source_record_policy: Reuse the existing source record without modification. This review supplies additional bounded evidence for the four selected reactive formulations; it does not rewrite earlier selection history.

inspection.method: Recomputed the retained original publisher PDF hash, read the existing bounded retrieval receipt, visually inspected cached page images 1, 3, 5 and 12, and searched the retained complete PDF text for relevant tensile conditions and processing qualifications. During candidate correction, the same cached PDF was additionally rendered and visually checked on pages 4 and 15 for gel specimen scope and reference [32].
locators: PDF p.1: article identity, the two authors and article-specific CC BY 4.0 notice.

PDF p.5, section 3.1 and Table 1: contextual nonzero gel fractions for the four selected reactive formulations.

rights_review.permission_locator: PDF p.1, article-specific author copyright and open-access notice.
rights_review.attribution: Ewurum, N.; McDonald, A. G. Lignin Reinforcement in Polybutylene Succinate Copolymers. Polymers 2025, 17, 194. https://doi.org/10.3390/polym17020194
rights_review.selected_content_scope: Selected original Table 6 modulus cells and statistical qualifiers, Table 1 contextual gel fractions, and bounded author-authored identity and method facts.
rights_review.selected_table_credit_check: No separate third-party credit or reuse restriction appears on the inspected Table 1 and Table 6 or their relevant captions and footnotes. Cited outside studies and their values are excluded.
rights_review.curation_changes: Selected facts are transcribed into structured records with study-qualified identifiers, explicit unknowns, source locators and authored scope qualifications. This is factual transcription and curation, not a verbatim source-table asset or a claim of independent scientific validation.
rights_review.excluded_assets: The original PDF, page images, complete source tables, figures, prose dumps and raw measurements remain outside the repository.

identity_review.basis: Four source-qualified PBS/Indulin AT lignin formulations prepared with DCP by reactive extrusion, distinguished from one another by the reported 10, 20, 30 and 45 wt.% lignin loadings. The source explicitly distinguishes the DCP-containing reactive Rxx series from the simple-blend Bxx series.
identity_review.reaction_evidence: Section 3.1 and Table 1 report nonzero gel fractions of 4.7, 4.3, 12.7 and 26.2% for R10, R20, R30 and R45. Together with the explicit DCP-containing formulation, these support a source-qualified chemical-formulation/reaction distinction; new identities are not inferred from an R label, extrusion conditions or specimens alone.
identity_review.gel_fraction_scope: The gel_fraction_percent strings in selected_facts are contextual identity evidence only. This candidate adds no gel-fraction property or inferred crosslink-density measurement. Section 2.4 (PDF p.4) determines contextual gel fractions on hot-pressed DCP cross-linked PBS-lignin material, not the injection-molded tensile dog-bones. These results support formulation-level reaction context only and do not determine the tensile specimens’ gel fraction or final network.
identity_review.input_identity: PBS is reported as Mitsubishi Chemical Group BioPBS FZ91PM/FZ91PB; lignin is Westvaco-supplied Indulin AT softwood kraft lignin; DCP is an input identified as 99% purity. These are input descriptions, not analytical purity or final-composition claims for the products.
identity_review.grade_ambiguity: The combined FZ91PM/FZ91PB designation does not establish which individual PBS grade was used. Rxx labels are study formulation labels, not certified grades.
identity_review.dcp_basis_limit: Preserve '0.25 wt.% DCP added to PBS' as reported. Its precise denominator is unresolved; do not normalize a total-composite recipe, infer final retained DCP, conversion, crosslink density, network architecture or exact final stoichiometry.
identity_review.loading_basis_limit: The article states that lignin is a percentage of total polymer mass. This is a source-reported formulation input basis, not an analyzed final-composition assay.
identity_review.existing_source_join: At the frozen baseline, the source-to-property-to-state-to-identity join represents B0, Indulin AT, B10, B20, B30 and B45. Each selected B blend explicitly excludes its reactive R counterpart. No R-series identity was found in that finite source join.
identity_review.novelty_boundary: This source review is not the complete frozen-catalog alias/equivalence audit or a global uniqueness claim. Separate candidate novelty evidence and identity-policy review are required before admission.
identity_review.prior_exclusion_boundary: Earlier B-series packets described DCP-reactive Rxx formulations as outside their selected scope. Those finite exclusions are retained and are not reinterpreted as prior R-series approval.
excluded_candidates: R0, whose distinction from the neat PBS comparator requires separate adjudication.
B0, B10, B20, B30, B45 and Indulin AT, which are already represented.
Other preparation states, test replicates, translated labels and supplier names as additional identities.

property_contract.statistics_boundary: The table expressly gives mean plus/minus standard deviation. It says SD has been rounded up to the mean's reported precision where necessary. Preserve displayed values; do not reconstruct unrounded uncertainty, raw observations, a standard error or a confidence interval.
property_contract.tukey_scope: Superscript letters are Tukey grouping labels for reported comparisons at p < 0.05. Preserve b′, b′, b and a for the selected modulus cells; do not treat them as uncertainty units, numerical precision or additional material identities.
property_contract.replicate_boundary: Section 2.9 states 10 tensile replicates. This does not establish 10 independent manufacturing batches, population representativeness or access to specimen-level raw data.
property_contract.instrument: Instron 5500R-1132 universal test machine with Bluehill v3.3 software
property_contract.unknowns_boundary: Do not import laboratory defaults, standard-derived dimensions, preparation temperatures, disc geometry or flexural-test replicate counts into the tensile record.
property_contract.standard_locator: PDF p.5 section 2.9 and p.15 reference [32]
property_contract.standard_edition_basis: Source-cited edition only: section 2.9 cites reference [32], which names ASTM D 1708-18 and 2018. Independent compliance remains unverified; no dimensions or conditioning are inferred.

preparation_context.dcp_pretreatment: DCP was dissolved in acetone and mixed with milled PBS; the mixture was left in a fume hood for 24 h and then dried in a vacuum oven at 80 degrees C for 12 h.
preparation_context.extrusion: Separate 50 g formulations were fed to a Wellzoom EZ3DX single-screw extruder, 10 mm diameter, at 140 degrees C to make 3 mm diameter strands, then cut into pellets.
preparation_context.tensile_route: Portions were compounded with a Dynisco Lab Mixer Molder/Extruder at 100 rpm for 10 min at 140 degrees C and then injection-molded into dog-bone specimens. The reported compounding temperature is not independently specified as an injection mold temperature.
preparation_context.separate_route_excluded: The 120 degrees C hot-pressed discs, 75 mm die and 3.1 mm disc thickness describe a separate route and are not assigned to tensile dog-bone geometry. Section 2.4 uses hot-pressed material for the contextual gel-fraction test; that measurement is not transferred to tensile dog-bones.
preparation_context.state_boundary: Preparation temperature and drying time are not tensile test temperature or post-molding conditioning. No additional identity is created for a processing state.

review_correction.reason: Independent candidate review identified a source-cited standard edition that the earlier candidate incorrectly marked unknown, and requested explicit separation of gel and tensile specimen states.
